summary: Quality-driven Information Technology Manager with over 10 years experience aligning business systems with business policies and guidelines while managing IT support and application development operations. Looking to bring strong management, analytical and problem-solving skills to an industry-leading technology company.

experience.title: Information Technology Manager
responsibilities: Managed computer support staff for a college serving over 150 employees.
Planned and implemented major upgrades to the college’s computing environment.
Participated in IT Governance to develop infrastructure and security policies.
Oversaw help desk support, troubleshooting hardware, software, and Windows servers.
Managed multiple projects to develop applications and IT solutions for faculty, staff, and students.
Administered data needs, including data security, database development/maintenance, and report generation.
Responsible for purchasing appropriate computing equipment.

experience.title: System Analyst
responsibilities: Managed staff for new system migration project.
Generated SQL for data population and complex report writing using PL/SQL and Crystal Reports 9.
Maintained and improved existing databases.
Created tools using Visual Basic and SQL to assist Housing Specialists.

experience.title: Graduate Assistant-Technical Writer
responsibilities: Developed user manuals and training materials for computer systems used by police personnel.
Tested web and client-server applications to ensure user requirements were met.
Utilized web development tools to create online user manuals.

experience.title: Co-Founder, Business Manager
responsibilities: Managed all aspects of business operations for a non-profit performance arts organization.
Developed marketing materials for community outreach.
Wrote grants to secure funding for youth and out-of-school programs.

experience.title: Applications Developer
responsibilities: Documented user requirements for rewriting billing systems.
Led development team in requirements gathering.
Provided support for billing systems, troubleshooting complex queries.

experience.title: Programmer Analyst
responsibilities: Performed tasks in all stages of the SDLC for a disability claims system.
Created Oracle database objects (views, queries, PL/SQL, SQL) for reporting.
Developed testing strategy and led testing team for the system.
